limitations: Seven unique exposed development questions in five overlapping story groups; no human-canon or held-out acceptance.
Legacy and ordered corpora, operating points and factual-assertion units are reported separately.
The 4000-byte comparison does not establish quality at the 1200-byte default.
Historical extraction, corpus and judge disagreements remain unresolved unless separately evidenced.
